description: Main source file for a Flutter app implementing a login screen and a calculator UI with logic. Contains widget classes, state management, and application entry point.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter app, sets theme and initial route to login screen.

classes.name: _LoginScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the login screen with username and password fields.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State implementation for login screen, manages input validation and navigation to calculator.

classes.name: _CalcOp
classes.description: Enumeration of calculator operations: add, subtract, multiply, divide.

classes.name: _CalculatorStateMachine
classes.description: Encapsulates calculator logic and state, handling input, operations, and formatting.

classes.name: _CalculatorScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget displaying calculator UI and handling user interactions.

classes.name: _CalculatorScreenState
classes.description: State implementation for calculator UI, managing button presses and display updates.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, runs the root MyApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for various widgets: sets up UI layout for login and calculator screens.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles login submission, validating input and navigating to calculator.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers in login screen.

methods.name: _tap
methods.description: Handles calculator button presses, updating calculator state accordingly.

methods.name: _button
methods.description: Creates calculator keypad buttons with styling.

methods.name: _applyOp
methods.description: Performs basic arithmetic operations on double values.

methods.name: _commitPendingIfPossible
methods.description: Evaluates pending operation in calculator state machine.

methods.name: backspace
methods.description: Deletes the last character in current entry or resets if error.

methods.name: inputDigit
methods.description: Inputs a digit into the calculator.

methods.name: inputDecimal
methods.description: Inputs a decimal point into the calculator.

methods.name: toggleSign
methods.description: Toggles the sign of current entry.

methods.name: setAdd
methods.description: Sets addition as the pending operation.

methods.name: setSub
methods.description: Sets subtraction as the pending operation.

methods.name: setMul
methods.description: Sets multiplication as the pending operation.

methods.name: setDiv
methods.description: Sets division as the pending operation.
